item.title: How to freeze an object in JavaScript
item.description: Preventing object modifications is crucial for maintaining data integrity and avoiding unintended side effects in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve found that immutable objects are essential for building reliable applications. The most effective way to make an object immutable is using the Object.freeze() method. This approach ensures that no properties can be added, removed, or modified after freezing.
